summary.headline: Protean Q4 FY26 revenue rose 38% YoY to INR 308 crores, helped by INR 44 crores one-time storage charges; FY26 revenue INR 998 crores, up 18.7%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue reached INR 308 crores (up 38% YoY), including INR 44 crores of storage charges that management described as multi-year and non-recurring at that level. EBITDA was INR 53 crores (margin 16.5%, up 208 bps), and adjusted PAT was INR 31 crores after a INR 75 lakh one-time Labour Code impact. For FY26, revenue was INR 998 crores (up 18.7%), EBITDA INR 188 crores (17.6% margin), and adjusted PAT INR 105 crores, with the company debt-free and holding over INR 850 crores in cash and marketable securities. Management flagged an Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK) rollout that will add cost ahead of revenue, and announced Ajay Rajan as MD and CEO from 1 June 2026.

financial_highlights.change: +38% YoY vs INR 222 crores in Q4 FY25; includes INR 44 crores storage charges
+53% YoY; PAT margin 9.6%; excludes INR 75 lakh one-time Labour Code impact
+27% YoY from INR 149 crores; margin 17.6%, +125 bps

segments.name: Tax Services (PAN)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 498 crores, up 17.5% YoY; 59% market share; more than 4.7 crore PAN cards issued in FY26. Processing charges around 35% of revenue in FY26, guided to 35-38% going forward.

segments.name: CRA Services (pension)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 304 crores, up 7.5% YoY; over 1.5 crore new CRA subscribers (13% growth), 96% share of incremental additions; over 3,000 corporates onboarded, a record. PFRDA revised charge structure, which management said will dip margins short term.

segments.name: Identity Services
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 92 crores; management cited volume growth across most foundational ID products, with focus on eSignPro, RISE with Protean and KYC Search & Reporting.

segments.name: New Businesses
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 103 crores, nearly 3x YoY; about 10% of total revenue vs 3-4% last year. Includes CERSAI CKYCRR 2.0, Bima Sugam and 44 ASKs live across 20 states and UTs (of about 190 planned).

guidance_outlook: All ~190 Aadhaar Seva Kendras targeted live by Sept-Oct 2026; full-scale revenue expected around Feb-Mar 2027, with older centres contributing from Q4 FY27.
Processing charges to stay in a 35-38% range of revenue, depending on the mix of online, assisted online and physical transactions.

Margin improvement targeted each year, with significant expansion aimed over the next 2-3 years; no near-term margin guidance given, and management acknowledged a timing mismatch from ASK costs that will weigh on margins.
Storage charges of INR 44 crores not expected to recur at that level; next year will be lower, with yearly storage revenue over the next 2-3 years.
Order book above INR 1,500 crores as on date.
New businesses targeted at about 25% of total revenue in 2-3 years.
Ajay Rajan joins as MD and CEO from 1 June 2026.
capex_capacity: 44 of about 190 Aadhaar Seva Kendras operational (around 23%); the 190 are split into Phase I, II and III under the RFP; 34 were live before 31 March 2026.
About 2,000 employees to be hired for ASKs, mostly entry-level; management declined to quantify the employee cost increase.
Asset-light model; management said ASK managed-service projects carry no working capital gap, with payment in 30-60 days.
Cash to be used for the dividend (about INR 44 crores), working capital, platform investment and growth.
demand_pricing: Bima Sugam: management said the mandated health and motor product lines must go live within 3-4 months; revenue recognised on effort-based percentage of completion, with milestones used only for billing. Recurring maintenance revenue to follow implementation (first ~2 years) over 5-7 year contracts.
Storage charges of INR 44 crores relate to PAN document storage under a contract with the Income Tax Department, recognised on receipt basis; matching processing cost also booked in the quarter.
PAN 2.0: management said no change in its position; distribution model expected to continue for 12-18 months before the impact is clearer. PAN 2.0 is not yet live on IT department infrastructure.
International: Ethiopia agri platform win; Africa pipeline; management noted a slowdown in the current month due to Middle East geopolitics and slower decision-making.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR 44 crore storage income recurring, and what is the EBITDA split by business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the INR 44 crores is new income for 2-3 years and will not be the run rate; next year will be lower. Segment EBITDA is not disclosed; IR to guide on modelling.

qa_highlights.question: How much ASK revenue and margin to expect at full rollout?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 44 are live, all 190 by Sept-Oct 2026; full revenue after 3-4 months. Margins per project not disclosed due to confidentiality; no working capital gap.

qa_highlights.question: What are Bima Sugam's revenue size and recognition?
qa_highlights.answer: Management confirmed the project is turnkey with implementation revenue ramping this year and maintenance after implementation; total contract value not directly confirmed on the call.

qa_highlights.question: How does PFRDA's CRA charge revision affect margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is a short-term margin dip, with a long-term benefit as AUM-linked charges grow; margin accretion vs the past 2-3 years is not expected in the short run.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the consolidated tax rate below 25%?
qa_highlights.answer: Legal rate 25.17%; consolidated rate has run at 22-23% historically due to lower-tax entities (Dubai, among others); Dubai profit is not yet meaningful.

qa_highlights.question: Why does APY enrolment (9 crore+) differ from the public subscriber count (7.5 crore)?
qa_highlights.answer: IR said the deck counts enrolments net of deletions for dormant or inactive accounts.

risks_watch: ASK rollout timing mismatch: staffing and infrastructure costs ahead of revenue could compress margins in the next 1-2 quarters; management declined to size it.
Storage charge revenue (INR 44 crores) is lumpy and depends on Income Tax Department acceptance; Q1 FY27 will show the base after the one-off.
PAN 2.0 distribution model is unresolved; the decision could come in 12-18 months.
PFRDA charge revision: short-term margin dip in CRA.
Bima Sugam go-live within 3-4 months on a mandated timeline; any slip affects implementation revenue.
CEO transition to Ajay Rajan from 1 June 2026.
Geopolitical slowdown in international deal decisions; the timing of the Ethiopia revenue start is not quantified.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, cash and the long-term DPI opportunity, but cautious and often non-specific on near-term margins, ASK economics, segment profitability and PAN 2.0. Management repeatedly declined to quantify project-level revenue, costs and margins, citing confidentiality and the absence of segment reporting.
